scope: Independent review of the nine standard action rows only. Intermediate registered imagegen artwork, before final edge cleanup. No look directions, installation, packaging or final application playback reviewed.
reviewed_by: gothic_standard_qa independent subagent; visual comparison plus read-only Pillow decoding and alpha-region inspection
method: Viewed canonical-base.png and qa/contact-sheet.png, then all nine decoded GIF frame sequences at original 192x208 cell resolution. Checked every frame and last-to-first ordering using actual GIF durations. This is frame-sequence/timing review, not a claim of testing playback inside Codex.
identity_and_costume: Consistent pale sage long hair, purple eyes, dark purple/black ruffled headband with cream rose/bow ornaments, high-collar layered purple dress, pale vertical trim, waist ties, chains/star accents, dark gloves and strapped shoes. Small lace/chain details simplify at native size, but character identity and costume silhouette match the canonical base.

idle.action: Subtle breathing/sway and a blink: eyes close around frames 2-3, then reopen. Both shoes remain planted.
idle.loop: Frame 5 returns close to frame 0; no pronounced reset or positional jump.
idle.quality: Stable head/body ratio and dress silhouette; no crop or limb loss.
idle.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
idle.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

running-right.action: Clear right-facing three-quarter profile, forward hands and slight hair/skirt response. Screen-left shoe lifts in frames 0 and 4; the other shoe lifts in frames 2 and 6; intervening frames give two-foot contact.
running-right.loop: Alternating lift/contact cycle is legible; frame 7 contact returns to frame 0 lift.
running-right.quality: Direction is clear, both distinct shoes participate, body height and planted-foot baseline remain stable. Small steps rather than a broad running stride.
running-right.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
running-right.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

running-left.action: Clear left-facing three-quarter profile. Screen-left shoe A visibly lifts in frame 0; screen-right shoe B lifts in frames 2, 4 and 6. Frames 1,3,5,7 show two-foot contact. Both different shoes genuinely leave the ground.
running-left.loop: Actual eight-frame order is A/contact/B/contact/B/contact/B/contact, including frame 7-to-0. All frames are 120ms except frame 7 at 220ms. The loop is complete and readable as a restrained leftward shuffle, but favors B and has an uneven stepping rhythm.
running-left.quality: Accepted minor rhythm limitation, not a claim of regular alternating gait. Direction, feet, silhouette and baseline remain readable; no missing shoe or teleporting body.
running-left.gait_rationale: A complete cycle contains distinct lifts of both feet and intervening contacts. Repeated B steps make the pace lopsided, but do not invalidate this small-step desktop movement. A perfectly symmetric four-frame template is not required.
running-left.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
running-left.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

waving.action: One hand rises beside the face, opens/outward-tilts and lowers again across four frames. Feet stay planted; the greeting is readable at native size.
waving.loop: Frame 3 lowered hand returns close to frame 0; compact greeting loop.
waving.quality: No arm detachment, extra limb, clipping or prominent scale jump.
waving.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
waving.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

jumping.action: Small hop with hands close to the chest, skirt opening slightly and both shoes raised together. Registered foot lifts are 0/4/8/4/0px.
jumping.loop: Grounded first and last frames surround a shallow up/down arc. No large leap.
jumping.quality: No top/bottom crop; body/dress respond through the hop without a sudden gross size change.
jumping.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
jumping.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

failed.action: Eyes lower/close, head bows, torso and knees settle into a deep disappointed crouch, then recover to standing. Frames 3-4 are low poses, followed by recovery in frames 5-7.
failed.loop: The large height reduction follows a visible crouch trajectory, rather than arbitrary frame registration. Upright final pose returns close to the first.
failed.quality: Hands, hair, skirt and shoes remain connected/readable; the skirt broadens during crouching as expected. No clipped head or missing limb.
failed.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
failed.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

waiting.action: Standing waiting/questioning gesture: one palm opens toward the viewer side, head tilts slightly, then returns.
waiting.loop: Frames 0 and 5 are similar resting poses; gesture completes before the reset.
waiting.quality: Distinguishable from idle by the open-palm gesture; stable feet, volume and silhouette.
waiting.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
waiting.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

running.action: Task-active/focused interpretation, as specified: standing thinking pose with a gloved hand near the chin, restrained expression changes and blink. This is not a locomotion row.
running.loop: Small head/face changes return to the initial thinking pose without a body reset.
running.quality: Both feet stay planted; no crop, detached hand or substantial proportion shift. Action is deliberately subtle.
running.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
running.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

review.action: Standing scrutiny/review: hands lower together near the waist, head tilts/bows and eyes narrow/close before looking up again.
review.loop: The bowed middle poses recover toward the upright endpoint; last-to-first is restrained.
review.quality: Distinguished from focused running row by lower hand placement and clearer head bow; difference is subtle at native size but visible. No major limb or silhouette defect.
review.clipping: No frame touches the 192x208 cell edge in review.json; visual margins confirmed.
review.transparency: No visually obvious unintended large interior puncture or broken limb at native size. Cyan contour residue and tiny alpha gaps remain in this intermediate extraction and require final-alpha QA.

accepted_minor_warnings.observation: Uneven A/contact/B/contact/B/contact/B/contact cadence; shoe B lifts three times per cycle versus shoe A once. Reads as a small shuffle with a favored foot, not an evenly alternating run. Both shoes do lift and direction/loop remain clear.
Fine trim, chain and hair-line details vary slightly between generated poses. Native-size costume identity and overall proportions remain coherent.
Focused standing thinking and scrutiny are understated. Their hand placement/head tilt differ, but the distinction relies on these small gestures.

Cyan contour residue and tiny enclosed transparent pixels exist in the intermediate frames. They were not used as grounds to fail action QA. Final cleaned spritesheet transparency/edge quality must be checked separately.

alpha_region_check.method: For all 57 RGBA PNG frames, flood-filled alpha==0 components using 4-connectivity; excluded components touching the cell boundary. Screened for visually disruptive interior holes, with all regions over 20 pixels above y=170 enumerated.
alpha_region_check.result: No enclosed zero-alpha component larger than 20 pixels had top y<170 in any standard frame. Larger lower-frame regions are the visible gap between legs/shoes. Numerous one-pixel/thin contour gaps remain; native-size visual inspection found no obvious face/torso puncture or broken limb.
alpha_region_check.limitation: Area screening supports the visual review and does not certify every alpha pixel or final edge cleanup.
